Description: This AIM edits an Audio Object and composes Audio Objects into one. One Object is open at a time, so a User Command need not name its target: it acts on what is open. The Object Port accepts a Basic Audio Object or a full Audio Object and the AIM knows which it was given from the value's Header - an Object holding one Object is Basic, an Object holding more than one is full, so the kind is a fact about the content rather than a declaration about the channel. Composing a Basic Audio Object with another Object produces a full Audio Object; removing all but one produces a Basic Audio Object again.
